output.summary: An annual vine native to South and Southeast Asia, sponge gourd bears cucumber-shaped fruit that turns brown and strongly fibrous when fully ripe. Young fruit is eaten as a vegetable, while ripe fruit is inedible and used as a scrubbing bath sponge.
output.edibilityNote: Young fruit is eaten; shoots, flowers and leaves can be cooked, mature seeds roasted, and edible oil extracted from seeds.
